comments.body: Done in the commit after 361245ea (feat(window): Let Return confirm Delete Group): confirmDelete passes confirmOnReturn: true; Escape cancels; a GUI-tier test pins it.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, at triage on 2026-11-01: pressing Return should confirm the Delete Group question.

Right-clicking a group under the tabs and choosing Delete Group asks first (`confirmDelete` in `Sources/MusterMac/MusterWindow.swift`), and today only a click on the Delete Group button confirms, because `ConfirmSheet` never binds Return to a confirming button. The ⌘W card needs the same change to `ConfirmSheet`, and one per-call choice serves both. Escape keeps cancelling.
title: Return confirms Delete Group
